answer: The jade token system enforces identity bondage by requiring a physical hardware device plugged into a local USB port to sign transactions. Each identity must prove a live human is present through a unique biometric scan matched to the token. An attacker pays a costly per-identity fee of buying a new physical device and losing it, which is impossible to fake because they cannot replicate the required hardware. The security model resembles a nebula of interconnected safeguards, each as resilient as a trellis supporting a growing structure.
